north_star: Know what authority your AI agents have, what changes when integrations are introduced, and whether those changes have been approved.
positioning: The authority lockfile and PR security gate for AI agents.

assessment_model.capability: What a component can potentially do
assessment_model.exposure: How reachable that capability is and under which identity
assessment_model.security_finding: Evidenced violation of a defined security property
assessment_model.authority_layers: DECLARED | CONFIGURED | EFFECTIVE | VERIFIED (passive scan = DECLARED/CONFIGURED only)
assessment_model.declared_vs_effective: Host profiles declare configuration; effective permissions stay NOT VERIFIED without host/runtime evidence
assessment_model.decision: BLOCK | REVIEW | NO-GATED-FINDINGS (unparsed agent configs fail closed as REVIEW; baseline mode is new-only; NAME_MARKER never gates; require_review classes auto-fail; gated findings require evidence_ids)
